svg.text: NEMA14 JST · actual CP2 and buzzer copper
Separate comparison: 43 traces / 22 vias. Accepted controller and prior baseline unchanged.
CP2: EP 0.820 mm · native square 0.360 mm · real circle 0.619 mm; rule stays 0.15 mm.
Buzzer external copper: flyback 13.325 mm; switch 35.399 mm including 2.843 mm barrel travel.
Baseline pad-edge lower bounds: flyback 56.265 mm; switch 37.928 mm. No baseline routed loop exists.
Blue: charge pump / Kelvin · Orange: buzzer TOP · Purple: supply INNER2 · Green: driver returns
Nominal full placement: 0 shorts / spacing / courtyard findings. 60 nets remain open.
Unapproved small-hole process; 24 width-stress spacing findings. Physical handling and CAM unverified.
Diagram shows actual native copper. It is not a completed or fabrication-qualified controller.
